note: Completion columns use the stored formulation (completed / all qualified starts; mean over profiles with >=5 qualified starts, pooled over all eligible profiles). Abandonment columns use known outcomes after censoring (profiles with >=5 known outcomes). Continuation uses profiles with >=5 observed opportunities for the mean and all eligible profiles for the pooled rate. Pooled rates weight observed outcomes rather than profiles equally; with almost no censoring, stored and known completion coincide.
